title: Barry C NDE 1037
content: I found myself in a perfect blackness (not a tunnel), I could feel space around me. The blackness was so deep and velvet-like. In front of me, I saw a very bright light, but not a blinding one. I started to approach the light, it grew bigger, and bigger and finally, it turned into a great light ball around which I started to move, just like a planet. The ball was radiating love and tolerance, masculine power and indifference to who I am and what I have done - it was only important that 'I was'. I couldn't get into the light although I was very close. I wanted to be in the light so much. There was wisdom, acceptance, love and creative power in the light. I woke up then and I can't remember anything else.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Suicide attempt Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening I took a lot of medications.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes My hands were joined and I stretched them as if I wanted to jump to the water, I didn't feel anything like feet.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Space - just like outer space.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: No There was darkness around me but I didn't feel that I was in any kind of enclosure, I felt space. There was a bright point in front of me.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Uncertain There were no other beings; the point of light was a being or a whole group of beings.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Very bright light, but not blinding. It was getting bigger as I was coming closer to it.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Blissful state, weightlessness, flying, amazement, joy.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe But I can't remember what it was about. I knew answers to questions but I can't remember what these questions were. I was overcome with joy because of that.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I experienced acceptation and tolerance. When you are near the point of light it is not important who you are, it us important just that you are.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: No I knew I had to go back. I had no choice, I felt a loss, and I didn't want to come back.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I'm peaceful and stoical (that's what my family and friends say)
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain Sometimes I can predict the future, especially someone's death and I guess I have a small gift of healing people.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Everything was wonderful, apart from my return.
